question: Which of the following universities won the Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy 2021?

options.text: Chaudhary Charan Singh University, Uttar Pradesh

solution:
The correct answer is **"Panjab University, Chandigarh".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad trophy** is awarded to the top-performing University in sports and promoting competitive sports.
 
• Maulana Azad was one of the leaders of the Indian independence movement and the **first Minister of Education.**
 
• This trophy is awarded by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.**
 
• In the year 2021, it was awarded to Panjab University, Chandigarh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Award**
 **Given to**
 **In 2021, won by**
 
 

 **Arjuna Award**
 It is given to sportspersons for consistently outstanding performance over the period of the last four years.
 Shikhar Dhawan, Arpinder Singh,etc.
 
 

 **Dronacharya Award**
 It is given to coaches for producing medal winners at international events.
 Jai Prakash Nautiyal, Sarkar Talwar, etc.
 
 

 **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna**
 It is given to sportspersons for the most outstanding performance by a sportsperson over the period of the last four years.
 Mithali Raj, Sunil Chhetri, etc.
 
 

 **Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar**
 It is given to organizations and individuals for playing a visible role in the area of sports promotion and development over the period of the last three years.
 MREI, Oil and natural gas corporation.
